size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)

machine.type: machine-shop fitout per the node continuous note's authority (AQS-MFG-010 rev C, Table 2.1): bench deck over a 20 mm plinth inside a four-post hold-down/guard frame that pins the registry box (X-PAR-04), with the six shop machine tools as purchased-class envelopes per plan rule 6 - CNC vertical mill (7.5 kW), engine lathe (5.5 kW), band saw (1.5 kW), rotary-screw air compressor (4.0 kW), TIG/MIG welder (6.0 kW), bench grinder/drill-press/hand-tool set (2.0 kW); connected 26.5 kW, one 8 h shift, average 2.55 kW; shop-air DN15 header with four drop legs on the compressor service
machine.tool_roster: AQS-MFG-010 Table 2.1 (rev C metering split): the four metal-forming tools (melt, atomiser, mill, drawer) are metered at their own units and are not part of this fitout; the AQS-EQP-MFG-001 polymer-line massing tags (shredder, wash/dry, extrusion, injection, sheetpress) are area equipment, not graph units

benchset.note: Bench grinder, drill press, hand tools

machine.metering: connected 26.5 kW frames the MCC-1 feeder with the roster (AQS-MFG-010 section 3); coincident peak 24.5 kW
machine.guard: four-post hold-down/guard frame (40 x 40 posts, top rails) is the A-MACH guard + 8 slab anchors (fasteners.csv)
machine.material_basis: duty section 3: 316L where the stream is wet; CA 0 mm (AQS-STD-001); dry shop machines
machine.study_dims: machine envelope footprints are study values (WORK_ORDER W12); the maker prints govern at order
